sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 180. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes Slumber from all allies.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Recovers 25 Cost.
Only [Master Musician] Beethoven can be used as Unlocking Potential material
